title: Inline line grid: the always-present trailing "ghost" row reads as a broken, undeletable blank line next to "Add line"
body:
## Symptom

In a master-detail New/Edit form with an inline line grid (`inlineEdit: 'grid'`), `GridField` always appends an empty entry row. In 18.6.0 this is `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`, `hasGhost` / `displayRows`, around line 1225.

On an existing record with N lines, users see line N+1 with no product, an empty amount, total "—" and an empty date picker. It has no copy or delete actions (they are suppressed by `!isGhost`). It sits directly above the 「添加行」 button, which does the same job.

Saving ignores the row: the batch carries no operation for it. So it is purely presentational. Business users still report it as a bug — "a blank line I can't delete" — on both our sales order grid and our quote line grid.

## Ask

One of the following:

- drop the ghost row when an explicit Add button is shown;
- render it as a clearly styled "click to add a line" placeholder, not as a data-looking row;
- expose a per-field switch (for example `inlineGhostRow: false`) so an app can keep Add without it.

Today the only way to hide it is `allowAdd: false`, which also removes Add.

Version: @objectstack 18.6.0.
